text:
Ivy (Design): Dropping a compact variant of the token list and a new flow for rotate that mirrors create (reveal + copy + audit). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/newflow/token-compact. Main asks: make copy/reveal accessible, make high-privilege tokens visually distinct without color-only cues, and tighten the revoke confirmations. Oscar (Frontend): Compact list looks good. One practical ask: keep the copy button visually small but ensure it meets touch target size. Also put the show/reveal control before the copy in DOM order. Liam (A11y): Agree on DOM order. When reveal happens, move focus into the region and announce: "New token revealed. Copy now; it will not be shown again." Use aria-live=polite and role=region. Example:
New token revealed...
. Maya (Security): For admin-scoped tokens add a shield icon and an explicit sr-only label: "High privilege token". Also require typed-confirm for revoking org-level admin tokens. Priya (PM): UX copy proposals: reveal microcopy: "This value is shown only once. Copy it now." Empty state heading: "No API tokens yet" body: "Create a token to use the Redwood API. Tokens are shown once; copy them now." Primary CTA: "Create token". Rae (QA): Found a keyboard bug in the compact list: Tab order jumps from row actions to page nav, skipping the expiry selector. We'll make a checklist to ensure linear tabbing: name -> scopes -> expiry -> reveal -> copy -> more actions. Ivy (Design): For revoke, propose two-tier flow: personal tokens get a checkbox + undo snackbar (10s). Org/admin tokens get typed-confirm + checkbox. Copy for snackbar: exactly "Token revoked. Undo". Oscar (Frontend): Backend will return header `X-Token-Visibility: one-time` when the secret is returned and `X-Token-Admin: true` for admin scopes. We'll consume both. Also will emit analytics events: token.create, token.copy, token.rotate, token.revoke. Maya (Security): Good. Also emit audit events with properties: user_id, token_id, scope_summary, copied=true/false. Block copy if policy denies (return 403). Show inline error: "Copy blocked by policy: contact admin." Liam (A11y): For the copy confirmation don't use a transient purely visual tooltip. Provide an aria-live polite message: "Copied to clipboard. This token will not be shown again." Keep focus stable on the Copy button. Rae (QA): Test matrix I'll add: reveal + copy + aria-live on VoiceOver and NVDA, rotate-reveal consistency, revoke typed-confirm gating, and clipboard-fallback when navigator.clipboard unavailable. Also timing for undo snackbar (10s). Priya (PM): One more: analytics should include expiry_days and visibility in the payload. Also track whether user used typed-confirm for revoke. Ivy (Design): I'll update Figma with: compact row ARIA notes, shield icon for high-privilege, explicit expiry defaults in microcopy (90d org / 30d personal), and revoke typed-confirm states. Tagging @Oscar @Liam. ci-bot: Preview build available: https://preview.redwood.ai/pr/323/token-compact. Use for QA and accessibility checks. Oscar (Frontend): I'll prototype the compact row in storybook and include keyboard tests. Will ping when PR is up. Maya (Security): Quick checklist for implementation: audit events for create/copy/revoke/rotate, header flags X-Token-Admin and X-Token-Visibility, typed-confirm enforcement server-side for org admin tokens. Priya (PM): Thanks all. Ivy, aim to land the design updates today and I'll open tracking tickets for analytics, backend, and QA. Ivy (Design): Will do. Leaving comments on Figma now. :sparkles:
